purpose: HISTORICAL SW2018 EXEMPLAR EVIDENCE ONLY. It proved selected PMI transport behavior; it is not a full manufacturing-drawing content authority.
source_rule: Reuse the current V10 linked drawing base and a dedicated copied P007 authoring model. Never mutate proven evidence sources or canonical CAD.

manufacturing_route_rule.effect: Route OPEN blocks route/process-dependent release claims, but does not block D2 authoring of route-independent controlled claims C01.DATUM_A, C02.DIAMETER_FIT and C09.MATERIAL.

model_semantics.C01.DATUM_A: Native datum A on the controlled J2 mating face; target annotation-view role AV_J2_LONGITUDINAL.
model_semantics.C02.DIAMETER_FIT: Native DimXpert diameter Ø14.10 H7, no shaft fit; target annotation-view role AV_J2_LONGITUDINAL.
model_semantics.C09.MATERIAL: AISI 316L / EN 1.4404 native material/property and title-block projection.

support_only_not_release: C05 Diameter4 may remain Ø33.00 with tolerance NONE for design-review support; it is not D7 release-native coverage until its release variation semantics are controlled.

manual_drawing_sequence: Open the prepared linked exemplar SLDDRW; do not create a new drawing.
Use an axial full section as the PRIMARY longitudinal representation for P007. The external longitudinal view is redundant for the current hollow/stepped geometry and may be hidden.
Use the flange end view as SECONDARY for the 3-hole pattern, flange/locator semantics and end-view readability.
Use one isometric view only as an AUXILIARY form-comprehension view; it carries no release dimension authority.
For relevant drawing views use SOLIDWORKS native Import annotations ON + DimXpert annotations ON + Design annotations OFF.
Historical action superseded: preserve valid C05 Ø33. Full release drawing content is coverage-based from current Product Definition.
D6 is layout only: move views/annotations/leaders, set permitted scales, resolve overlaps; edit no engineering value/tolerance.
Save the same SLDDRW and export/update PDF for D3/D7/D8 evidence.
prohibited: manual retyping of H7 or any released tolerance into the drawing
editing the proven Step13 PMI candidate or canonical P007
calling this exemplar a released manufacturing drawing

minimum: prepared drawing remains linked to the dedicated P007 exemplar model
C02 native model PMI reads as Ø14.10 H7 after save/reopen
C02 native DimXpert annotation is present in the drawing after manual import
V10 fallback semantic base remains traceable to the current drawing slice fingerprint
manual layout does not introduce a new tolerance/GD&T value
exemplar_acceptance.release_boundary: Exemplar acceptance is not P6 release. Full D3/D4/D5/D7/D8/D9 release-native chain remains required.

information_regression_rule: Never delete/hide a valid Product Definition characteristic merely to satisfy this historical exemplar scope.
